product.title: REVIVE Magnesium Glycinate
product.body_html:
Revive Magnesium Glycinate

A high-bioavailability daily magnesium glycinate supplement built for athletes, lifters, and active adults dealing with the cumulative effects of training stress — disrupted sleep, muscle tightness, elevated cortisol, and slow recovery. Particularly relevant for hard trainers whose magnesium needs run higher than average, busy professionals carrying daytime stress into bedtime, and anyone whose previous magnesium supplement caused stomach upset.

What separates Revive Magnesium Glycinate from the average magnesium tablet comes down entirely to the form of magnesium used. Each serving delivers 200mg of elemental magnesium bound to glycine — one of the most bioavailable and absorbable forms available, and significantly gentler on the stomach than the cheaper magnesium oxide and magnesium citrate forms found in most budget supplements. Magnesium oxide in particular is poorly absorbed (research suggests under 5% bioavailability) and notorious for causing the laxative effect that puts most people off supplementation entirely. The glycine pairing has its own value: glycine is itself a calming amino acid that supports sleep and relaxation, so the formulation does double-duty for stress management and recovery. Documented magnesium glycinate benefits include support for muscle and nerve function, sleep quality, bone health, energy production, and the body's stress response.

Revive manufactures all of its supplements in the United States in facilities certified to GMP standards, and Magnesium Glycinate is Informed-Sport certified — meaning every batch is independently screened for WADA-banned substances by LGC's anti-doping laboratory. For competing tested-pool athletes in Sri Lanka, that's the level of third-party verification worth paying for.

  • 200mg of elemental magnesium per serving as glycinate — one of the most bioavailable and absorbable forms available
  • Bound to glycine — a calming amino acid that adds its own sleep and stress benefits to the formulation
  • Far gentler on the stomach than magnesium oxide or citrate — no laxative effect at recommended doses
  • Documented magnesium glycinate benefits include sleep quality, muscle and nerve function, stress relief, and bone health
  • Informed-Sport certified, vegan, gluten-free, and soy-free — among the most credible magnesium glycinate Sri Lanka options for tested-pool athletes and dietary-restricted users

Pair it with a daily multivitamin or recovery supplement from our vitamins and supplements range to round out a complete daily wellness routine.
